summary:
I fixed both "should" problems and both nits in /home/user/ppolppol-fix-owner. Nothing is committed, and every new check fails when its fix is undone. I left the two "owner" items (OW-3, OW-4) alone.

OW-1, the earned weekly gift lost after the update: a saved week whose "이번 주에 사흘 들어오기" slot was already done no longer loses that point. The game counts it as done when the player came in on three days of that week, today included. If the slot is replaced during that week, the week keeps one extra done point (`week.kept`, saved). The list still reads 5/5, the claim button and the bag-chip dot come back, and pressing 받기 gives shells 12 and seeds 2. If the week ends before the slot is ever replaced, Monday's check counts the old slot from the visit days, so the unclaimed gift is still put in. To explain why only four rows show 했어, one plain line appears under the note for that week: "사흘 들어오기는 목록에서 빠졌지만, 이번 주엔 한 걸로 셌어." The font check says `stale: none`.

OW-2, the press during the awake period after a turn: the code was already right. What was missing was a check, and new check Q22 adds it.

Nits: I removed the dead `questMark('gift')` call (OW-6). I rewrote the comment on the new-week fallback to say it is a guard that cannot be reached today and has no check (OW-5).

Suites: Q passed 62/0 four times, the last three in a row. Z passed 47/0 and A passed 74/0. npm test passes on a re-run. The first npm test run failed because the machine's disk was full ("no space left on device"); I freed the space my own scratch copies had taken and ran it again. Y crashed twice at an older check that gives a sheet's close button 5 s to appear. The untouched base ae505a3 crashed at the same place under the same load, so Y gives no verdict.

changes.what: New `oldDone(w, x)`: true for a 'days' slot when the player came in on three days of that week. It counts `user.days` plus today, because a repair at page load happens before the day gift writes today.
changes.why: This is how the old task read its progress, kept only to honour points already earned.

changes.what: Same-week repair: before the slots are replaced, every done 'days' slot adds 1 to `w.kept`. The existing save() writes it.
changes.why: The replacement slot starts at 0, so without this the week fell from 5/5 to 4/5 and the button and dot went away.

changes.what: The `due` check at the week change uses `weekOk(x) ? questDone(x) : oldDone(w, x)`, plus `w.kept`.
changes.why: A last week whose 'days' slot was never repaired (no visit that week after the update) still gets its unclaimed gift on Monday.
One change feeds the (N/5) note, the claim button, weekClaim and the bag-chip dot together.

changes.what: One set-note line (#week-kept), shown only while `w.kept` is set: '사흘 들어오기는 목록에서 빠졌지만, 이번 주엔 한 걸로 셌어.'
changes.why: Without it, the sheet shows (5/5) next to only four done rows, which looks like a bug.

changes.what: The comment block above QUESTS now mentions the kept point, and the save format lists `kept?`.
changes.why: Docs for the weekly list live in this comment.

changes.what: Comment only: the new-week fallback is a guard that cannot be reached today (2D with no posters leaves exactly 7 tasks) and has no check.
changes.why: The checker found the old comment misleading.

changes.what: Removed the call `questMark('gift')`, with a short note.
changes.why: 'gift' has not been a weekly task since 66c8110, so the call did nothing.

changes.what: `ctxOf` in scenario Q takes `o.awake` (the test hook __ppolAwakeMs, default 0 as before).
changes.why: Q22 needs an awake period above 0.

changes.what: Q19 also checks that no `kept` is saved: two visit days do not count as the old task done.
changes.why: Guards the other side of OW-1: a slot that was not done adds nothing.

changes.what: New Q21, in two parts. Same week: a slot holding 'days', visit days on Monday and Tuesday, opened on Wednesday, and four other tasks done. It checks kept=1, the slot replaced, (5/5), the claim button, the dot, the aria-label, the explaining line, seven rows with four 했어 and none mentioning 사흘. It then reloads, checks the same, presses 받기 and expects shells +12 and the dot gone. Week change: last week holds 'days' with three visit days plus four other done tasks, and is opened on Monday. The gift must be put in (prev 12/2, shells 20 to 35 with the day gift).

New Q22 with a 10-minute awake period. A home turn counts 1/2. It waits until restPhase() is 'awake', the scene octopus is not asleep and the saved state is 'sleep'. Then it presses 산책 갈래? and expects 2/2 in memory and on disk, with exactly one new turn.
changes.why: OW-2: the awake period after a turn must count as awake.

decisions: OW-1: the checker suggested two ways to keep the point: give the replacement slot full progress, or count the point toward WEEK_NEED. I counted it at week level (`week.kept`) and did not mark the replacement slot done. A filled slot would show 했어 for a task the player never did, which is misleading text. The point is earned only when the player really came in on three days of that week, as the old task counted. Today is included, because a repair at page load happens before the day gift writes today; on ae505a3 the old slot would have filled to 3/3 a moment later. Because (5/5) next to four done rows would look broken, I added one plain line that appears only for that week. It is the only new player-facing text, and the font check passes. OW-2 needed no code change; the code was right and only a check was missing. Of the nits, I removed the dead call (OW-6) and kept the fallback with a corrected comment (OW-5), since removing it fails no check either way.
new_text: 사흘 들어오기는 목록에서 빠졌지만, 이번 주엔 한 걸로 셌어. (살림 › 이번 주 할 일, set-note #week-kept, shown only in a week that kept the old task's point)
guard:

Mutation table. Each fix was undone alone in a scratch copy, built by repair-owner/mut/make.py, and Q was run. Logs are in /tmp/claude-0/-home-user/779b4de3-ceb6-5233-b661-33f83b7682a5/scratchpad/final/repair-owner/mut/:
- R1, the repair no longer adds to `w.kept`: 60 passed, 2 failed. Both Q21 same-week checks fail (kept null; claiming gives 44 to 44).
- R2, `due` no longer counts the unrepaired 'days' slot: 61 passed, 1 failed. The Q21 week-change check fails (shells 20 to 23, no weekly gift).
- R3, `weekDoneN` no longer adds `kept`: 60 passed, 2 failed. Both Q21 same-week checks fail (kept is 1 but there is no (5/5), button or dot).
- R4, today not counted in `oldDone`: 60 passed, 2 failed. Both Q21 same-week checks fail (only two visit days on disk at the time of the repair).
- R5, the checker's MY1 mutant (`woke = oct.state === 'sleep' || S.octopus.state === 'sleep'`): 61 passed, 1 failed. Q22 fails (1/2 to 1/2, saved 1).

I deleted the mutant copies afterwards to free disk space and kept the logs.
